answer: The rule groups identities by their behavioural signature and applies the penalty to the whole group at once. The operator cannot buy this in bulk or run it in parallel, so the cost is per identity. The oasis is the collateral at risk, the whisper the behavioural signature that groups identities, and the nectar the joint forfeiture that punishes the group: splitting into many whisper groups avoids the joint loss but scatters the oasis into smaller, individually useless stakes.
